[[Claws of the Kinslayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[dagger]] found in the [[Chest of Burrows]] after killing [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] in [[Frostmaw's Burrows]].

==Stats== 
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as [[Demon Fangs]].

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Chkkr's Pincers]], [[Faveo's Daggers]], and [[Stygian Daggers]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Deldrimor Blades]] and [[Droknar's Blades]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Slashing damage]].
*[[Shiro's Blades]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Slashing damage]] and require 13 [[Dagger Mastery]].
